provider_source.source_of_truth_boundary: AOF artifacts, Mission Control projections, release docs, and runtime audits are canonical; chat text is not release evidence

event_summaries.summary: Heartbeat required AOF to continue the roadmap using latest runtime and trend context.
AOF runtime selected v12.0 as provider-backed operator decision console after v11.9.
Mission Control schema, visibility export, viewer display, release docs, and evidence artifacts were added.
visibility-export projected provider_backed_operator_decision_console from provider decision, freshness, runtime safety, and tool governance evidence.
Role outputs and Council review framed v12.0 as read-only operator Go/No-Go support, not provider write permission.
Decision console must not be misread as provider truth, semantic truth, credential safety, production execution safety, or autonomous external write authority.
Stop release if v12.0 claims provider write authority, production safety, or semantic truth.

risk_candidates: decision console may be mistaken for provider execution permission
decision_candidates: advance to v12.1 only after v12.0 proves read-only operator decision console

redaction_boundary: summaries only; no secrets, credentials, private provider payload bodies, or private transcript content exported
release_ready_boundary: release-ready requires runtime audits, tests, smoke, and CI/tag validation, not this export alone
not_proven: Session export proves traceability for v12.0 release work only; it does not prove provider truth, semantic truth, production safety, market value, or autonomous external write authority.
